title: Normative Primitives for Capability Studio Gate A1
description: Defines WireDigest, genesis-zero sentinel, TypedFP, ContentDigest, Instant, SemanticVersion, and closed domain registry for Target A1. Draft 2020-12.

WireDigest.description: WireDigest format: sha256: prefix + 64 lowercase hex chars. Excludes all-zeros by pattern constraint. Per 00 §2.1.

genesisZero.description: Sentinel for uninitialized state. Distinct from any valid WireDigest.

WireDigestOrGenesis.description: Either a valid WireDigest or the genesis-zero sentinel.

domainLabel.description: Closed registry of registered domain labels for TypedFP computation. Exactly the 19 v1 domains per 00 §4.1. Case-sensitive; no regex.

unitType.description: Closed registry of source unit types. Per 01 §1.2.

oracleType.description: Closed registry of oracle types. Per 04 §2.1.

releaseStatus.description: Release status. NON_RELEASE is the only allowed value for Target A1 oracles. Per 04 §2.1.

expectedOutcome.description: Expected outcome for attack case validation. Per 04 §3.4.1.

actualOutcome.description: Actual observed outcome during attack case execution. Per 04 §3.4.1.

Instant.description: ISO-8601 instant with UTC timezone. Aliases timestampISO8601 for semantic clarity in hermetic timestamps.

SemanticVersion.description: Strict Semantic Version 2.0.0 string. Per 01 §3 and §4.1.

relativePath.description: Relative path within a source package. No leading /, no .., no absolute paths. Per 00 §3.

unitId.description: URN-style identifier for a source unit. Per 01 §1.2.

roleVisibility.description: Array of role names that can see this unit. Per 01 §1.2.

TypedFP.description: Domain-labeled semantic fingerprint. SHA256(ENC(domain) || ENC(JCS(payload))) as WireDigest. Per 00 §2.3. Domain must be in the closed domain registry.

ContentDigest.description: Raw content digest. SHA256(raw bytes) as WireDigest. No ENC encoding. Used for stdout, stderr, jar, treeFile. Per 00 §2.2.
